title: E-QTM-0161: mixed states and a POVM from ancilla vibes on the rule's own gates, partial: two ancilla loves meeting...
purpose: Experiment E-QTM-0161 in the quantum arena: mixed states and a POVM from ancilla vibes on the rule's own gates, partial: two ancilla loves meeting one arm with a coin between give 4 outcomes whose effects sum to I exactly, are not projectors and do not commute (not a sharp reading shuffled by noise), and give Born's probabilities on the part exactly on 5 inputs; not informationally complete (the effects span 3 of 4 real dimensions); one coupling leaves the part mixed (purity 23/32) inside a pure whole; with equal points nothing is recorded; gates read bit for bit on 17 of 17 starts, the schedule arranged.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
